description: This PHP source file provides a class-based implementation for parsing, creating, and manipulating XML files. It defines classes for XML tags and entire XML documents, supporting reading from files or strings, writing to file handles, and managing XML structures in memory.

classes.name: XMLTag
classes.description: Represents an individual XML tag, its attributes, nested subtags, and character data. Provides methods for managing tag attributes, subtags, and XML serialization.

classes.name: XMLFile
classes.description: Manages an entire XML document, including a root tag, and provides methods for reading from files or strings, writing to file handles, and cleaning up structure references.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the class, initializing version and encoding for XML handling.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Recursively clears subtag references to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: create_root
methods.description: Creates and initializes the root XML tag.

methods.name: read_file_handle
methods.description: Reads XML data from a file handle and parses it into the internal structure.

methods.name: read_xml_string
methods.description: Parses an XML string into the internal structure.

methods.name: write_file_handle
methods.description: Writes the entire XML structure into a file handle.
